summary: OUR ep 25 ('Mash Burnedead and His Good Friends', 2024-03-30) is the Season 2 finale, which mashle.fandom numbers Episode 24 (S2E12) — our numbering runs one ahead of the wiki in late S2 (verified by title+air-date on wiki E22/E23/E24 vs our rows 23/24/25). The wiki's adapted_from field gives Chapters 73, 74 and 81: chs 73-74 close the Divine Visionary Selection Exam arc (Innocent Zero fight aftermath), while ch 81 ('Mash Burnedead and the Excellent Friends' — the episode's exact Japanese title, and its page reverse-links the episode) is a scene grafted forward from the next arc (the mob discovering Mash can't use magic). External guides confirm S2 covers through ch 74 with the Tri-Magic-Athalon arc (75-102) next, so END=74 with ch 81 as a graft and continue at 75. The stored ep24→74 anchor is wrong per the wiki (our ep24 = wiki E23 = chs 71-72) — repair included.
